# Cyril Baah

> DevOps Engineer & Solutions Architect specializing in cloud-native infrastructure, CI/CD automation, and AI-driven DevOps practices.

Cyril Baah is a DevOps Engineer and Solutions Architect focused on building scalable infrastructure, automating deployment pipelines, and ensuring reliable, high-performance systems. His work spans cloud-native solutions and CI/CD pipelines across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, with a growing focus on integrating AI into DevOps operations (MLOps, intelligent automation).

## Skills

- **DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure**: AWS, GCP, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi), CI/CD (Jenkins, CircleCI, Azure DevOps), microservices architecture
- **Solution Architecture & Design**: Distributed systems design, security architecture (IAM, encryption), event-driven architecture, database architecture (SQL, NoSQL), cloud storage & data management
- **AI & Machine Learning for DevOps**: Python automation and scripting, Kubernetes AI pipelines, database automation

## Volunteer Experience

Community and Project Engagement Volunteer, Tech4good Africa (January 2025) — supported the planning and execution of community-centered initiatives and projects.
